About this demo

This is scripted playback of curated examples using the same rules as this website’s typing preview. It is not a recording or a speed test of the Mac app. The browser has a small, authored vocabulary; the Mac app uses separate native logic.

All four displayed languages are enabled throughout. Ambiguous readings wait for your choice. Undo correction restores the latest example. In the editable browser preview, use its Undo correction button; standard browser undo does not reliably restore automatic corrections yet.

The Mac app is in development. Its public installer is not available yet. See the current Mac status.
